Complete [[The Great Northern Wall]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Scout the enemy territory north of the [[Great Northern Wall]] and assess the strength of the [[Charr]] army.
* *BONUS* Find and return the four pieces of [[Kilnn Testibrie]]'s armor to his tomb.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[The Great Northern Wall#Walkthrough|The Great Northern Wall]] mission.
